folds.heading: ## Generated-body reconciliation B125, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full GRAMMAR/VALIDITY/SAVE_SHAPE/SAMPLES/REPORT read. Preserve B6-G1–G7/V01–V10/S1–S5 and all20 fixture tuples: mechanism, actual trigger/consumer, optional cost, discovery, transmission and local naming/rarity remain distinct. Cohort prevalence is not strength or access; a label, source origin string or body-sex presentation does not establish genealogy or reproductive function. Actual event-time parent/donor/template inputs freeze independently of later discovery. Destination law may suppress operation without erasing source or refilling fuel. Empty valid pools produce their declared ordinary outcome, not silently substituted magic.

Read-only recomputation of the frozen ASCII FNV tuple/label keys reproduced all20 saved hashes, tuple selections and names, exhausting the7/7/6 QA decks with zero mismatches. This verifies documentation examples only: without-replacement coverage is not population odds, source truth, a lifetime quota or implemented stream behavior. Its algorithm label is an opaque fixture revision; the stated XOR-then-multiply recurrence, key format and stored outputs are the actual reproducible contract. Required fictional parent/issuer/body records and action handlers are assumed/specifed fixture inputs, not actual generated families or gameplay.

Historical body.gen proposal and uncertain-P1 fallback are qualified by the existing named-stream service inspected in [B18 AB11](../b18/INTERFACES.md#ab11-seeded-draw) and B111. Reuse admitted families/saved root before a deliberately selected provider/migration; never claim recovery of an original root from a moving cursor. Permanent card/cause/outcome authority is not a prunable RNG/history log. Pin resolvable definitions and minimum event inputs, avoid second writable body/claim/stock stores, preserve absent old state and reject incompatible active definitions before publication. Card-instance support, quotes, actual loader/preflight and rollback remain selected implementation work, not satisfied by JSON serialization or a source-list grep.

Current [PROJECT](../../../../../PROJECT.md) retires one-realm/one-prestige; Frontier/home is a cheap test fixture, not renewed depth priority. AD42 optional human review and AD51 shared design from known needs in [RULES_INDEX](../../../../RULES_INDEX.md) qualify old gates. A1–A5 and finite archetypes remain proposals, with no new world, generator or source-kind registration. Original13-file SHA receipt, external/peer readback and source absence are historical evidence, not this pass’s primary-source reading or renewed runtime proof. No card acquisition/use, clock/RNG runtime, schema budget, save/import or desktop behavior was exercised.
